conditions-native.title: Skyrim condition native field and function-index facts
conditions-native.use: Manually observed field widths/order/targets5913-6106, function-index/type facts2313-2718, flag facts1219-1310 and parameter-category facts2746-2819; reference-only run-on fact Common849-869. Independently authored schema, no reference-file parsing or Pascal translation.

conditions-ck.title: Creation Kit condition meaning
conditions-ck.use: Event function/member share one native four-byte slot; optional event comparison data is a separate slot. Primary page observed through search2026-10-08. Conditions/category direct fetch403; binary facts pinned to xEdit.

members.name: flags_and_operator
members.source: conditions-native: low five bits are flags; upper three bits masked 224 are comparison operator: 0 equal, 32 not_equal, 64 greater, 96 greater_equal, 128 less, 160 less_equal; 192 and 224 unknown. No decoded bit-slice is claimed.
